about: A server that streams video from torrents while they download, so a TV or player can start watching right away.

prs.title: Ukrainian and other Cyrillic subtitles now show every letter
prs.broken: Subtitles saved in an old Windows Cyrillic format only had Russian letters mapped. Ukrainian, Belarusian and Serbian letters, and signs like the copyright mark, came out as question boxes.
prs.changed: The converter now knows every character in that format, in both directions.
prs.matters: Viewers watching with Ukrainian or other Cyrillic subtitles can read every line, and the original file can be downloaded unchanged.

prs.title: Titles with a percent sign are no longer lost
prs.broken: When a torrent was added with a title like 100 percent Pure Show written with the percent sign, the server decoded it twice, failed, and saved no title at all. Posters, categories and searches had the same problem.
prs.changed: The server still tries the second decode, but keeps the text as it arrived when that fails.
prs.matters: Torrents keep the names people give them, and searches with a percent sign still work.

prs.title: Episode 1 now comes before Episode 10
prs.broken: Files with unpadded episode numbers were listed out of order: Episode 10, 11 and 12 came before Episode 1. Playlists followed that order, so a player started at episode 10.
prs.changed: The sort now compares the whole episode number, so 1 is weighed against 10 as a number.
prs.matters: A season plays from the first episode in the right order.

prs.title: The combined playlist plays the episode it names
prs.broken: With the option to merge all playlists into one turned on, entries could play a different file than their name said. The combined list and the stream used two different sort orders.
prs.changed: The combined list now sorts files the same way the stream does before numbering them.
prs.matters: Picking an episode from the combined playlist plays that episode.

prs.title: Resetting settings turns the network services back on
prs.broken: Resetting settings to defaults stopped media sharing, network discovery and the search service and started none of them. The defaults said discovery was on, but the server was not visible until a restart.
prs.changed: A reset now restarts each service that the new settings turn on, the same way saving settings does.
prs.matters: After a reset the server shows up on the network without a restart.
